cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've held that spoon up to the light, so I've checked mine the same way. Is it bright enough for Mum's lunch?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was checking my reflection. You still haven't cleaned the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, reflections matter. Could you check the forks while I polish this one? Mum notices cutlery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've asked her to bring gloves and help you clean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll need a guest towel. Help me find one without a faded stripe; I want it ready when she takes the gloves off.

reason: Use concrete copied misunderstandings to shape control, quiet restoration, detail diversion, protective handling or inquiry, with each B contribution changing A's next move.
